summary: Claude approval cards say why Claude asked. The Claude adapter reads the SDK's canUseTool decisionReason and matchedAskRule into a new optional request.opened.reason, and every client shows it as a Reason line on the card. In full access the adapter used to allow every ask; now an ask that carries a matched ask rule, or a decisionReasonType of rule or safetyCheck, opens a card that starts with 'A safety check or your ask rule stopped this action.' An edit tool in Auto-accept edits gets the same card for such an ask. Other asks in those modes are still allowed without a card, and Plan, Supervised and Auto decide as before; they only gain the Reason line.

storageDataMigration.reason: No table or migration. The reason is an optional field on the live request.opened event and on the approval item the clients already keep. Android writes it into its thread snapshot JSON as an optional key, and snapshots written before this change have no key and read back with no reason.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, update channel or capability changed. The field is optional: an older client ignores it and shows the card as before, and a newer client facing an older backend gets no reason and shows no Reason line.

automated: tests/unit/claude-adapter-approval-reason.test.ts drives the real ClaudeAdapter canUseTool with a mocked SDK: a decisionReason and a matched ask rule land on request.opened.reason, no reason when the SDK gives none, full access opens a card for a safetyCheck and for an ask rule with the full access sentence first, accept edits opens a card for an edit tool a safety check stopped, plan mode still allows a read-only tool with a safetyCheck or an ask rule with no card, a plain full access ask is still allowed with no card, and the bare {decisionReasonType: 'rule'} payload that Claude Code 2.1.301 sends for an ask rule (no matchedAskRule) opens a card in full access and accept edits with the fallback reason 'An ask rule in your settings matched.'
tests/unit/provider-event-reducer.test.ts and tests/unit/pending-request-recovery-desktop.test.ts keep the reason on a live and on a recovered desktop card.
apps/mobile jest src/screens/__tests__/feed-items.test.tsx shows the reason on the Expo approval card; apps/mobile tsc passed.
npm run typecheck, the full vitest suite and npm run validate:feature-parity passed.
notExercised: The Android change was not compiled or run here (no gradle on this job). ThreadEventDecoderTest has a new case; Android CI on the pull request is the first build.
No real Claude CLI ask was run. decisionReasonType is passed by the SDK at runtime but is not in its published types; the safetyCheck value was read from the installed CLI build, not observed live.
The full access change touches an agent permission boundary and has not been tested on a packaged build from existing user data.

Deferred, follow-up 'hub wake or parent signal when a child opens a card': a Full access chat with no person watching (a hub child with a full-access grantedMode, or a turn from a peer message or the queue) can now wait on a forced-ask card with no timeout, and the hub parent gets no wake. The user sees the card in that child chat; nothing signals the parent.
